Pathetic service; this guy is a total fraud. Visit at your own risk. He will say one thing initially, then make excuses and demand more money. Even after paying a large sum, you will not get your phone back in good condition.

I went to his shop in October. My S21 FE phone had network connectivity issues. He said the IC needed replacing and charged ₹1200. I agreed and left the phone. When I called to check on it, he made excuses and asked me to come back the next day.  I eventually went to his shop and saw my phone had new issues—a dot on the screen, likely from careless repair. I took my phone, but it started restarting every 10 minutes. When I told him, he said he would check it. He kept my phone for four days, then said the motherboard needed replacing and couldn't be repaired. I lost all my data and had to pay ₹7500. He gave me a motherboard from another S21 FE phone. When I asked about the screen dot, he said it would disappear with heat from use. Instead, it grew larger, making the phone unusable. When I returned to show him, he said it was irreparable, with only a 10% chance of repair. When I said he broke it during the repair, he said, "This happens in repairs; if it's damaged, it's your responsibility."
I will take legal action against him soon.
